goals: Verify fetching a direct message thread by ID.
Verify fetching all messages associated with a direct message thread via messageConnection.
Verify that messageConnection correctly fetches the most recent message when requesting the first item and provides accurate pagination info.
Verify that messageConnection correctly handles pagination using cursors to fetch subsequent messages and updates page information accordingly.
activities: Define a helper function 'messageToPlainText' to convert message content to plain text.
Find a specific user ('mxstbr') from test data and set it as the context user for requests.
Filter test messages for a specific thread ID ('dm-1').
Sort the filtered messages by their timestamp.
Define a GraphQL query to fetch a direct message thread by its ID.
Set the expected number of assertions for the test to 1.
Execute the GraphQL query to fetch the direct message thread.
Assert that the query result matches a stored snapshot.
Define a GraphQL query to fetch all messages within a direct message thread.
Set the expected number of assertions for the test to 1.
Execute the GraphQL query to fetch all messages.
Assert that the query result matches a stored snapshot.
Define a GraphQL query to fetch the first message (which is the latest) from a direct message thread.
Set the expected number of assertions for the test to 2.
Execute the GraphQL query to fetch the latest message.
Assert that the 'pageInfo' in the result indicates 'hasNextPage' is true and 'hasPreviousPage' is false.
Extract the content of the fetched latest message.
Extract the content of the last message from the pre-filtered test data.
Convert both the fetched message content and the last test data message content to plain text.
Assert that the plain text content of the fetched message matches the plain text content of the last message from the test data.
Define a GraphQL query to fetch the first message (latest) and its cursor from a direct message thread.
Set the expected number of assertions for the test to 3.
Execute the first GraphQL query to fetch the latest message and its cursor.
Assert that the 'pageInfo' from the first query indicates 'hasNextPage' is true and 'hasPreviousPage' is false.
Extract the cursor from the result of the first query.
Define a second GraphQL query to fetch the next message using the extracted cursor.
Execute the second GraphQL query to fetch the next message.
Assert that the 'pageInfo' from the second query indicates 'hasNextPage' is true and 'hasPreviousPage' is true.
Extract the content of the message fetched by the second query.
Extract the content of the second to last message from the pre-filtered test data.
Convert both the second fetched message content and the second to last test data message content to plain text.
Assert that the plain text content of the second fetched message matches the plain text content of the second to last message from the test data.
